ideas.name: Feature-level evidence ledger
ideas.summary: Link every model parameter and geometric feature to a source document, coordinate range, evidence status, units, transformation and uncertainty; keep solver constraints separate from measured inputs.
ideas.next_check: Prototype a JSON schema that points from model parameter IDs to image/DXF entities and measured-value status.

ideas.name: Two-channel raster interpretation
ideas.summary: Keep OCR outputs and line/contour outputs in separate layers so OCR cleanup cannot erase geometric evidence and line extraction cannot silently reinterpret dimension text.
ideas.next_check: Compare extracted OCR boxes and line candidates against a raster-sketch fixture with known scale and dimensions.

ideas.name: Orthographic reconstruction comparison fixture
ideas.summary: Build a benchmark of simple prismatic, revolved and assembled parts with front/top/side views, dimensions, raster degradation and known CAD sources; compare rule-based, learned and human-assisted routes.
ideas.next_check: Check research repositories and dataset licences for redistributable fixtures and whether output preserves editable CAD feature history.

ideas.name: Representation-aware backend selection
ideas.summary: Route each job using required outputs: OCS for the established session workflow, FreeCAD for constrained feature history, code-CAD for reproducible exact B-rep source, and Blender/OpenSCAD for mesh or scene routes; record when a format conversion changes representation.
ideas.next_check: Run a controlled exact solid and mesh fixture through each installed backend and record representation and history outcomes.

ideas.name: Dimension and hidden-surface ambiguity queue
ideas.summary: Keep inferred values, obscured surfaces, uncertain symbols and competing projection correspondences in a small question queue; proceed only on independent geometry that does not depend on those items.
ideas.next_check: Design test cases where two distinct solids satisfy the same incomplete views and verify that the workflow reports both candidates.

ideas.name: Pose and unit adapter fixture across tool frames
ideas.summary: Create a small surveyed fixture with known 3D targets and images; round-trip pose matrices through OpenCV, COLMAP, Open3D, Blender and OCS, checking direction, handedness, units and projection error.
ideas.next_check: Confirm exact conventions and transform serialization supported by the installed versions.

ideas.name: Multi-sensor RGB-depth-LiDAR frame graph
ideas.summary: Represent camera intrinsics, RGB-depth extrinsics, LiDAR-to-camera transform, world controls and frame timestamps as one provenance-linked transform graph before fusion.
ideas.next_check: Define schema for transform direction, units, covariance/residual and calibration revision.

ideas.name: DA3 metric and COLMAP/MVS comparison on control object
ideas.summary: Capture an object with distributed measured controls and compare DA3 estimated depth/pose/cloud against COLMAP/MVS and independent lengths, reporting regional residuals.
ideas.next_check: Select nonreflective textured object and set held-out control distances before capture.

ideas.name: Camera-anchored stroke primitive semantics
ideas.summary: Use ray hits to anchor strokes and offer separate interpretations: surface trace, projected curve, selected planar sketch, or dimensioned datum annotation; store source component/face and camera state.
ideas.next_check: Specify user interaction for ambiguous occlusion and backface hits, then verify reprojected anchors.

ideas.name: Nerfstudio Splatfacto geometry export version test
ideas.summary: Resolve generic `ns-export tsdf` documentation (states all models) against Splatfacto FAQ (states mesh/pointcloud unsupported) for selected release and checkpoint.
ideas.next_check: At authorized implementation stage, identify version and test `ns-export tsdf` output existence, coverage, units and withheld control residuals.

ideas.name: Primitive-fitting method selection
ideas.summary: Compare plane, circle/cylinder/axis candidate fitters on known reference geometry, retain inlier point IDs and residual distribution, and compare fit stability under threshold changes.
ideas.next_check: Choose feature classes needed by actual scan-to-CAD fixture and document each fitter's objective and units.

ideas.name: CAD-to-cloud correspondence strategy
ideas.summary: Compare CAD semantic landmarks/PnP against FPFH/RANSAC+ICP for aligning scan to an existing CAD revision, especially partial and symmetric shapes.
ideas.next_check: Use withheld datum targets and report alternate pose failure cases.

ideas.name: Splat plus independently checked mesh layered scene
ideas.summary: Keep Gaussian splat for appearance, point cloud for sampled evidence, mesh for surface comparison and CAD solids for interpreted design as named layers carrying linked transforms and confidence/evidence labels.
ideas.next_check: Define a scene manifest with representation role, transform, unit, source and checks for each layer.

ideas.name: One canonical component schema with domain adapters
ideas.summary: Store identity, source/license, geometry representations, units/frames and physical values once; generate IFC, URDF, MJCF and visual exports through explicit adapters.
ideas.next_check: Prototype one mechanical component and one IFC product; document representation loss in each export.

ideas.name: Assembly to URDF workflow
ideas.summary: Use explicit joints and interface frames from CAD assembly as robot-description inputs; keep automated joint inference as a reviewable suggestion.
ideas.next_check: Compare FreeCAD assembly joint records to a URDF fixture and inspect one STEP-inference converter without treating its output as verified.

ideas.name: Open-chain and closed-chain robot models
ideas.summary: Use URDF for link/joint tree consumers; investigate MJCF native constraints or a multibody formulation for closed loops and parallel mechanisms.
ideas.next_check: Find current primary documentation for closed-chain mechanisms in the chosen robot simulator and define a loop-conversion fixture.

ideas.name: CAD solid to visual/collision/inertial triple
ideas.summary: Every robot link has separately authored high-detail visual geometry, simplified collision pieces and sourced mass/inertia attached to explicit frames.
ideas.next_check: Build a link with a non-convex opening and compare mesh collision, convex decomposition and primitive fit.

ideas.name: Plan plus scan to IFC as-built model
ideas.summary: Use measured scan alignment as surface evidence, plan interpretation for semantic element boundaries and IFC relationships for the building model.
ideas.next_check: Define registration-control/held-out-control split and document how uncertain wall/opening boundaries enter IFC.

ideas.name: CAD/STEP/B-rep fidelity gates
ideas.summary: Use STEP for geometry exchange while comparing the actual exporter/importer pair; source formats differ in whether they preserve analytic faces, assemblies and parametric history.
ideas.next_check: Use a cylinder, hole and two-part assembly fixture; report face types, names, bounds, volume and lost feature history.

ideas.name: IFC parametric element versus mesh representation
ideas.summary: Use parametric profiles/sweeps for elements where editability and quantities matter; use IFC mesh representations for complex as-built/furniture shapes and keep classification/property mapping explicit.
ideas.next_check: Export profile-extrusion and mesh forms of one element and compare import fidelity and IDS/property retention.

ideas.name: Scan to CAD with evidence labels
ideas.summary: Maintain scan, controls, fitted primitive/features, independent residuals and CAD source as separate linked representations.
ideas.next_check: Test one manufactured mechanical component with held-out interface dimensions.

ideas.name: Menagerie robot model reuse
ideas.summary: Reuse licensed MJCF structures and collision/visual examples as simulator fixtures or references, while checking each model's license and model-specific fidelity statement.
ideas.next_check: Select a model whose license permits the intended use and inspect its README, assets and revision before intake.

ideas.name: Rights-aware reusable asset catalog
ideas.summary: Store vendor CAD and community models with item-level rights and immutable source hashes; separate asset licenses from tool licenses and project license.
ideas.next_check: Create an intake record for one CC-BY component and one restricted manufacturer STEP download.

ideas.name: Poly Haven visual environment library
ideas.summary: Use CC0 assets and HDRIs to construct architectural and product rendering contexts; do not use asset dimensions as component specifications.
ideas.next_check: Assess asset metadata, scale indicators and dependency size for a visual scene fixture.

ideas.name: Blender scripting and MCP orchestration
ideas.summary: Keep OCS as engineering baseline; use deterministic Blender background scripts for repeatable conversion and checks, with MCP live inspection as a later interactive layer.
ideas.next_check: Compare scripted and MCP scene edits once the local Blender 5.0.1 compatibility constraint is resolved or a compatible integration chosen.

ideas.name: Menagerie robot plus scan environment simulation
ideas.summary: Combine an articulated robot description with a registered room or terrain mesh, then derive a simplified collision scene while keeping source coordinates and body frames linked.
ideas.next_check: Create a miniature scene with one articulated robot and one scanned obstacle; verify frame transforms and collision envelope.

ideas.name: Sketch-over-model revision workflow
ideas.summary: Align new sketch/image dimensions to an existing model datum, revise its native source, and regenerate geometry and visual exports without losing unrelated component identity.
ideas.next_check: Exercise a changed hole position against a pinned source model and compare a before/after measurement manifest.

ideas.name: Engineering asset quality classes
ideas.summary: Distinguish visual-only assets, approximate component geometry, dimensioned supplier CAD, measured parts and verified simulation models with explicit source evidence.
ideas.next_check: Define permitted downstream operations for each asset evidence class without presenting a license or visual source as engineering validation.

ideas.name: Shared frame and anchor record
ideas.summary: Use one versioned record to relate pixels, camera rays, scan coordinates, CAD datums and component IDs.
ideas.next_check: Compare transform direction, units and anchor round trips in the selected tools.

ideas.name: Source-to-feature association
ideas.summary: Retain each fitted or interpreted surface region and the exact CAD feature it supports.
ideas.next_check: Compare fitted-plane/cylinder evidence with saved feature and dimension readback.

ideas.name: Importer/exporter field mapping
ideas.summary: Maintain actual preserved/transformed/discarded field mappings per tool/version.
ideas.next_check: Run the same component and assembly fixtures through the intended consumers.

ideas.name: Ambiguous-view comparison
ideas.summary: Retain several geometrically consistent interpretations until source evidence distinguishes them.
ideas.next_check: Compare projected views and independent dimensions, with inference labels by feature.

ideas.name: Dependency-driven revision updates
ideas.summary: Record which branch depends on each measurement, component revision and interpretation.
ideas.next_check: Trace a single input change through affected recipes and derivative revisions.

ideas.name: Text-to-concept-image-to-mesh route
ideas.summary: Register a possible branch from text or sketch through a concept image to an image-conditioned mesh, then measured CAD remodeling.
ideas.next_check: Research an open image-generation backend and its exact weight/output terms before defining the first transition.

ideas.name: Procedural field geometry supplement
ideas.summary: Evaluate PicoGK/ShapeKernel as a separate source-driven geometry branch with explicit field/mesh resolution and OCS interchange checks.
ideas.next_check: Use the existing archived sources to define runtime/platform, output representation and comparison experiments.

ideas.name: Targeted first-pilot handoff review
ideas.summary: Resolve exact tools, representations, editable sources, unit/frame mappings and prerequisites for four route cards before the pilot experiments.
ideas.next_check: Produce four route cards and a bounded source-linked experiment list.

ideas.name: Shared records and fixture briefs
ideas.summary: Define model/evidence/artifact/component/check records and three dimensioned fixture briefs.
ideas.next_check: Check representation, identity and evidence fields against the selected routes.

ideas.name: OCS baseline pilot
ideas.summary: Exercise the existing OCS skill on a bracket and mating plate, including a revision, native save/reopen and measured derivative checks.
ideas.next_check: Record the actual installed capabilities and saved geometry for that fixture.

ideas.name: Text and drawing CAD pilot
ideas.summary: Compare text, raster sketch and DXF/SVG routes using the same dimensioned fixture and a complementary procedural-solid backend.
ideas.next_check: Compare dimensions, topology, editable source and importer readback.

ideas.name: Reconstruction and mixed-input pilot
ideas.summary: Combine photographs, controls, drawings or identified components into registered references and source-linked CAD remodeling, including anchored annotations.
ideas.next_check: Compare held-out measurements and regional scan-to-CAD deviations.

ideas.name: Architecture robotics and component pilot
ideas.summary: Exercise IFC building semantics, robot joint/physical-property handoffs and a pilot reusable component library.
ideas.next_check: Check loaded domain models, frames, geometry roles and source identities.

ideas.name: Package exercised skills and helpers
ideas.summary: Package exercised workflows with skills, scripts, examples, dependency records and shared CLI operations.
ideas.next_check: Run the relevant fixture and preserve actual execution evidence for each supported route.

ideas.name: Per-action software and AI options
ideas.summary: Define agent-led, hybrid, software-first exception and deterministic alternatives per action and supported input class.
ideas.next_check: Review the point-01 assignment of software, model and user responsibilities.

ideas.name: Evidence-based candidate comparison and merge
ideas.summary: Run alternative interpretations or software routes where useful; align their records, compare evidence and preserve per-feature provenance when a reasoning VLM proposes selection or combination.
ideas.next_check: Review conflict, source-precedence and post-merge validation cases.

ideas.name: Per-feature tolerance and intended-use requirements
ideas.summary: Separate dimensional accuracy, geometry detail, appearance, function, simulation and manufacturing requirements; attach tolerances to individual features and relationships.
ideas.next_check: Review the first-point requirement and tolerance record without introducing a sample design.

ideas.name: Tested replacement of specific agent actions
ideas.summary: Specify and test repeatable software functions for particular input classes while preserving agent-assisted exception routes.

ideas.next_check: Review proposed representative and failure cases before any implementation.

ideas.name: Local-compute-first point order
ideas.summary: Define source briefs and existing geometry before processing-heavy reconstruction; record local and remote resources separately.
ideas.next_check: Review each point in the plan order with its stated data size and output purpose.

ideas.name: Procedure design and independent review roles
ideas.summary: Use the requested Astra, Sol, Terra and Luna assignments for design, visual reasoning, independent review, software assessment and primary-source lookup.
ideas.next_check: Record actual task execution, source findings and reviewer dispositions separately from dispatch settings.
